fact: Gabonreview reports that on 28 April 2026 the DGI, CNSS and CNAMGS launched work on a single monthly wage declaration on one form accessible simultaneously by all three, with operation targeted for July 2026.

The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) provides for integrating the CNAM-GS social protection beneficiary registry into the Interoperability Platform and linking it to the RBPP ID system.
